title: The slap and "lost his cool"
situation: A 36-second video shows an Additional DCP slapping a woman protester near Parliament as police chase marchers; he is removed from protest duty. A police source says he "lost cool" and claims she had a nail-like object.

lines.text: The officer lost cool and committed the act.
lines.speaker: unnamed DCP-rank officer via ThePrint

paraphrased: Online calls for his removal; a former MP filed a complaint.

buildThis.situation: Serious beat: if a senior officer hits a friend and the player filmed it, the clip becomes the evening's main feed story and that officer is pulled off the line.
